review_record: A single public force-dynamic GET registered with withRequestLog returns APP_BUILD, env overlaySha or null, product minimum iOS build/store URL, and sanitized desktop minimum. Response sets no-store. PublicVersion reads the immutable private API on cold GET or HEAD, compares both revisions and five response fields. StartupGate, desktop update gate and web action/navigation consume these distinct fields. The pre-login HTTP read must carry no actor credentials. apps/api/scripts/cloudflare-web.test.mjs verifies encoded paths, cold read, stale overlay and failure recovery. Consumer references documented in prior #2506 G-002; no new deployment claim.
